evals.prompt: Copyedit this sentence: "It is important to note that our proposed novel approach may possibly be able to potentially achieve a significant enhancement in terms of the accuracy."
evals.expected_output: The agent applied academic-tone-editor: Make academic writing clearer and tighter without changing what it says.
assertions: The agent read the academic-tone-editor SKILL.md before acting
The agent marks what will not change: the claim's strength (tentative) and the term accuracy
